rationale: The Court will unanimously reject importing Safeco’s objective-reasonableness safe harbor into the FCA because § 3729(b)(1) defines scienter in subjective terms focused on contemporaneous knowledge, deliberate ignorance, or reckless disregard. One or more concurrences are likely to emphasize fair-notice limits and clarify that legal ambiguity remains relevant evidence on whether recklessness (or deliberate ignorance) is proven, without creating a categorical defense.
